content.short: Securr provides a unified security platform for Web3 projects, consolidating bug bounties and audits.
content.description: Web3 projects often contend with fragmented security tooling that struggles to provide proactive vulnerability discovery and efficient security management. That fragmented approach can leave assets exposed and budgets strained. Securr consolidates essential security services—such as bug bounties, audits, and vulnerability assessments—into a single platform, enabling teams to detect threats earlier, coordinate remediation, and manage security in a cost-effective, collaborative way.
content.meta: Securr offers a unified security platform for Web3 projects, consolidating bug bounties and audits. Discover Securr and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
